paper_title: What Does Neuro Mean to Cardio Investigating the Role of Clinical   Specialty Data in Medical LLMs
caption: Negative log-probabilities for clinically relevant tokens between baseline Mistral-v0.2 and the same model further fine-tuned on each specialty data. Each group represents tokens categorized into different clinical specialties. Each color means that the same model is further fine-tuned on each specialty data.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates negative log probabilities for tokens categorized into different clinical specialties, comparing a baseline model to the same model fine-tuned on data from each specialty. The horizontal axis displays the clinical specialties, labeled as Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, appearing in that order from left to right. The vertical axis represents negative log probability, ranging from approximately -27 to -22, with tick labels at intervals of 1. Each clinical specialty is represented by a group of three bars, visually distinguished by color: Cardio is represented in orange, Gastro in tan, Infect in orange, Neuro in orange, Obstetrics in orange, and Pediatrics in orange. The baseline Mistral-v0.2 is shown as a single light blue bar grouped with each specialty's fine-tuned bars. The shortest bar in the chart, at approximately -27, is the baseline model fine-tuned on Cardio data; the tallest bar, at about -22, is the model fine-tuned on Obstetrics data. The bars for each specialty generally appear to decrease in height, moving from left to right across the chart. No individual bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, or outlines.
